integrity: The proof derives the strict support criterion and the normalized Poisson law; the checker tests actual finite geometric configurations and quadrature, not infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Two concentric circles, independent area-angle-uniform samples, and asymptotic m_n/n to a strictly positive finite constant. No quantitative rate, central limit theorem, general smooth-curve extension, or independent validation. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: The two-circle boundary-layer law for random convex hull vertices
